title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode15 The Feeling That Day

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Waaah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, um, what's wrong? Why are you crying?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh, why am I talking to a toy as if it were a person...

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: *Sniff*... Bwaaah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't cry, don't cry!
Hmm... Look! Watch this, I'll do a snazzy dance for you!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Waaah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That only made it cry even more?!
I guess there's nothing I can do...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on, there's something else I could try, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Booohooo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, hey! W-Wonderhoy!
This is the Wonder Stage, a place fiilled with smiles♪

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Boo...huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Err... This time I want you to join in! Ready? Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Wonder...boy?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Close, but it's “hoy,” not “boy”!
Reach up and wave with both hands like this!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha! That's it! Now that you can do wonderhoy, you can consider yourself the prince's friend!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: What prince?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I'm the prince, of course! And that makes you my friend!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Oh! We're friends! Prince, can we go on an adventure now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Um... H-Hey, don't pull my arm!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Watch out, a storm's coming!
Our boat's tiny, things are going to get rocky!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: You hold on tight too, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's a powerful monster! How can we defeat it...

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: I think this sword will work on it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ha ha ha! That was a grand adventure!
And somehow... It feels really nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Me too, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, there's something written under your foot?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Saki”? Come to think of it, Saki used to have a bunny plushie, didn't she?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Could you be...Saki's bunny?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Saki and I used to play together lots!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, now that I think of it... You're not the only thing that's familiar around here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's the tent I used for my very first original show. And there's the poster I made, with me as the play's hero... That steam train and those decorations are mine too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course they are. This world is made from your feelings and memories!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Miku and KAITO! Have you been watching me all this time?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We were enjoying the show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were dazzling, like a real star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? It was just pretend play...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What matters is that you made our sad little friend happy again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I guess I did cheer it up... Wait a minute...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, why can't I go to school with everyone else?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I want to go to school and have fun with my friends...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Neiiigh!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm the defender of world peace! My name is Pegasusman!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to punish the evil sickness that's been making you sad, Saki! Come out, show yourself! You're hiding from me?! Saki, the enemy is a coward!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Pffft... Hahahaha! Pegasusman? Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I want to know all about his adventures!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I remember now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did all that because I wanted to cheer up Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At that show we saw together, the one that made me want to become a star...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I only decided to become a star because I wanted to be like the stars there, who made me and Saki so happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But at some point I forgot about all that, and all I cared about was making successful shows and becoming a star...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How could I have...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I hope our audience enjoys the play.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then. Let's work together to put on some unbeatable shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's my dream to have people come to see a show here at this stage and love it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're the real stars, not me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you're one of them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! Your little performance earlier was stellar☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It must have been because you remembered what really matters to you. And now that you have, you also have the power to make people smile again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But how can I make those guys happy again...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm sure you can.
Aren't you a future star that will bring joy to everyone?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's exactly who I am!
Thank you for helping me remember.
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no one here. I guess that's no surprise.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! I can't stand around feeling sorry for myself! I've got to go look for them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui may be doing one of his shows somewhere in the park. I have no clue how to find Nene, but Rui can help with that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm? Is that Emu over by the Ferris wheel?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, I... About what happened yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, do you want to ride the Ferris wheel with me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?
